verdict.rationale: SavvyCal is a scheduling-link and booking tool, so AI task scheduling is a fair question for it, but nothing in the evidence shows it placing a user's tasks into calendar blocks or re-planning them automatically. Related items do not deliver this story: time budgeting with calendar events only shapes availability for booking links, workflow steps follow a rescheduled meeting, and the MCP connection lets an outside client book meetings. These are adjacent features, not AI task scheduling.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, AI schedules my tasks into real calendar blocks around meetings and deadlines, and re-plans automatically when things change
